_exclude: The .js files are JavaScript copies of the JSON datasets beside them, and the check reads only the keys of JSON data. surah_spellings.dart lists the Latin spellings people use in file names and searches (Al-Fatihah, An-Nas), kept for lookup.
_ignore_words: wasl here is joining two ayahs in one breath (الوصل), not hamzat al-wasl.
_external_names: AudioSegment is pydub's class. Basmala and Isti'adha are special_type values in the imported segments files. tajweed is a Hugging Face model tag.
